sv.title: Uppgifter: Döende patient våldtagen på vårdhem
sv.summary: Polisen larmades till vårdhemmet på Lidingö i tisdags och hade en stor insats på platsen. Enligt uppgifter till TV4 Nyheterna utreder polisen en våldtäkt mot en kvinnlig patient på boendet. Hon ska ha vårdats i livets slutskede. Misstankarna riktades mot en annan patient, en man i 80-årsåldern.

en.title: Reports: Dying patient raped at care home
en.summary: Police were alerted to the care home on Lidingö on Tuesday and had a large operation on site. According to TV4 Nyheterna, police are investigating a rape of a female patient at the facility. She is said to have been receiving care at the end of life. Suspicion was directed at another patient, a man in his 80s.
